laws.rule: Western Wall plaza, as published by the Western Wall Heritage Foundation: eating, smoking and lighting candles are not allowed, and Torah scrolls may not be brought into the plaza. Not allowed in the complex: sharp tools, amplification (unless with a Foundation usher), balloons, musical instruments, alcohol, signs of any kind, and animals other than guide dogs. The page asks visitors to dress appropriately and gives no detail.
Western Wall plaza: on the Sabbath and Jewish holidays electronic devices, amplification, photography and writing are not allowed. The Foundation's page says nothing about photography on other days.
